calibration.binning_applies_to: answer_confidence, not full optionprobability distribution; perlanguageoverride bypasses globalbinning.
calibration.binning_threshold_caveat: Since 0.3.27, fit_abstention_thresholds accepts binning_map; pass the map the deployed gate reads. Per-language temperature overrides bypass global binning, so fit their effective language scales without the global map. Validate cuts on held-out served confidences.
calibration.procedure: Disjoint fit/thresholddevelopment/finaleval; validate bytype/options/language and deployedprecision; no threshold transfer assumed.
calibration.confidence_fields: entropyconfidence is notmaxp; answer_confidence ismaxp before optionalhistogrambinning.
calibration.coverage_ties: AURC and selective_accuracy include whole tied-confidence groups; selective coverage can exceed its nominal fraction. Regenerate definition-1 reports before cross-definition comparisons.
